name: Tzatziki
siboNotes: Traditional tzatziki contains regular yogurt which is moderate in lactose. Choose lactose-free Greek yogurt versions when possible for SIBO management.
preparationTips: Make with lactose-free Greek yogurt to reduce FODMAP content
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic to avoid fructans
Drain cucumber well to prevent watery consistency
Fresh dill and lemon juice are naturally low FODMAP flavor enhancers
alternatives: Lactose-free tzatziki made with lactose-free Greek yogurt
nutritionalHighlights: Probiotics from yogurt for gut health
